title.en: Garden oven with a hob built of white block

alt.tr: Bahçede, beyaz boyalı bloktan örülmüş ocaklı fırın ve altında üç ahşap kapaklı dolap
alt.en: Oven with a hob built of white-painted block in a garden, with three timber-doored cabinets beneath

caption.tr: Beyaz boyalı yapı sağ tarafta bacalı bir odun fırınına dönüşüyor. Dolap kapakları koyu vernikli ahşap, önünde çıplak toprak var.
caption.en: On the right, the white-painted structure rises into a wood-fired oven with a chimney. The cabinet doors are dark varnished timber and bare earth lies in front.
